target_definition: Hourly AC active energy in kWh over interval [H, H+1h) UTC

A.description: Production history, cyclical time encodings, and pvlib clear-sky features (no external weather forecast)

features.name: power_kw_lag_0m
features.description: 15-minute average active power of the latest interval ending at or before cutoff (interval [H-30m, H-15m))

features.name: power_kw_lag_15m
features.description: 15-minute average active power 15 minutes before cutoff (interval [H-45m, H-30m))

features.name: power_kw_lag_30m
features.description: 15-minute average active power 30 minutes before cutoff (interval [H-60m, H-45m))

features.name: power_kw_lag_45m
features.description: 15-minute average active power 45 minutes before cutoff (interval [H-75m, H-60m))

features.name: power_kw_last_4_mean
features.description: Mean 15-minute active power across the last 4 available intervals preceding cutoff

features.name: energy_kwh_latest_avail_hour
features.description: Total active energy of the latest fully available hour preceding cutoff (interval [H-2h, H-1h))

features.name: energy_kwh_prev_day_same_hour
features.description: Total active energy for the same hour on the previous day (interval [H-24h, H-23h))

features.name: energy_kwh_prev_week_same_hour
features.description: Total active energy for the same hour on the previous week (interval [H-168h, H-167h))

features.name: energy_kwh_rolling_mean_6h
features.description: Past-only rolling mean of hourly energy over the previous 6 fully available hours [H-7h, H-1h)

features.name: energy_kwh_rolling_mean_24h
features.description: Past-only rolling mean of hourly energy over the previous 24 fully available hours [H-25h, H-1h)

features.name: hour_sin
features.description: Sine of target hour H (sin(2 * pi * H / 24))

features.name: hour_cos
features.description: Cosine of target hour H (cos(2 * pi * H / 24))

features.name: day_of_year_sin
features.description: Sine of day-of-year (sin(2 * pi * DOY / 365.25))

features.name: day_of_year_cos
features.description: Cosine of day-of-year (cos(2 * pi * DOY / 365.25))

features.name: solar_elevation_target_deg
features.description: Solar elevation angle evaluated at midpoint of target hour [H, H+1h) (H + 30m)

features.name: clearsky_ghi_target_wm2
features.description: pvlib clear-sky Global Horizontal Irradiance at midpoint of target hour (H + 30m)

features.name: clearsky_energy_target_kwh
features.description: Clear-sky reference expected energy for target hour (clearsky_ghi * P95 ratio)

features.name: clearsky_index_latest_avail
features.description: Clear-sky index of the latest fully available hour [H-2h, H-1h) (clipped [0, 2]; default 1.0 at night)

features.name: production_age_minutes
features.description: Age of the latest available 15-minute production observation at issue time H (nominal 15 min)

features.name: power_kw_missing_count
features.description: Count of missing 15-minute readings among the last 4 intervals preceding cutoff (0 to 4)

features.name: latest_hour_missing
features.description: Indicator flag: 1 if the latest fully available hour [H-2h, H-1h) was missing or invalid; 0 otherwise

features.name: prev_day_missing
features.description: Indicator flag: 1 if same hour previous day [H-24h, H-23h) was missing or invalid; 0 otherwise

features.name: prev_week_missing
features.description: Indicator flag: 1 if same hour previous week [H-168h, H-167h) was missing or invalid; 0 otherwise

B.description: Feature Set A combined with NOAA HRRR NWP forecast weather (2m temperature, total cloud cover, Kasten-Czeplak cloud-adjusted clear-sky GHI, run age, fallback, missingness)

features.name: tmp_c
features.description: HRRR NWP 2-meter air temperature forecast averaged over leads F1 and F2 for target hour [H, H+1h)

features.name: tcdc_pct
features.description: HRRR NWP total cloud cover forecast percentage averaged over leads F1 and F2 for target hour [H, H+1h)

features.name: clearsky_ghi_cloud_adj_wm2
features.description: Clear-sky GHI adjusted by forecast cloud cover via Kasten-Czeplak parameterization: clearsky_ghi_target_wm2 * (1 - 0.75 * (tcdc_pct/100)^3.4)

features.name: weather_run_age_hours
features.description: Age of the HRRR NWP initialization run relative to issue time H (nominal 2 hours, higher if fallback)

features.name: weather_fallback_used
features.description: Indicator flag: 1 if fallback to an earlier HRRR run (>2h age) was used; 0 if nominal 2h run used or weather missing

features.name: weather_missing
features.description: Indicator flag: 1 if forecast weather data is missing/unobtainable; 0 if weather data successfully ingested
